subject: POC kickoff: access roadmap, owners, and success criteria (Apex Insights)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Morales <diego.morales@apexinsights.com>, Sasha Reed <sasha.reed@apexinsights.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up + POC access plan and owners (Apex Insights)

Thanks for the call this morning — good alignment on what success looks like. Quick recap and requested next steps so we can get your trial running next week: 

1) Success criteria (you confirmed these roughly on the call):
   - End-to-end inference latency <= 150ms p50 for 512-token prompts
   - Throughput target: sustained 40 qps across the test harness for 2 hours
   - Semantic similarity of embeddings >= 0.78 on your regression set
   - No data leaves your VPC during the trial (private deployment for eval)

2) Planned timeline:
   - Dec 2: network allowlist + SSO invites completed by Apex infra team
   - Dec 3: Redwood provision private trial, temporary API credentials issued
   - Dec 6-10: load/latency tests and two integration smoke runs
   - Dec 14: joint review, pass/fail decision and next steps (pricing/commit discussion)

3) Ownership:
   - Apex infra: configure IP allowlist, SAML SSO provider; point person: Diego
   - Apex procurement: sign NDAs/proc paperwork (Sasha)
   - Redwood: provisioning and test harness support — SE owner: Priyom Das; PM owner: Hannah

4) Access we need from you:
   - SAML metadata file or IdP admin contact for SSO invite
   - Static egress IPs to add to our allowlist (or CIDR ranges)
   - Service account email for setup OR confirmation you want us to create an internal Redwood-managed service account

Attachments: I attached a short success criteria spreadsheet and our minimal network requirements doc for the private trial.

Next steps: Diego/Sasha — can you confirm by EOD tomorrow that the allowlist + SSO timeline above works? Once we have that, Priyom will send an invite + temporary credentials and a short runbook for the first two test days.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

Thanks Hannah — quick confirmation from our side:

- Ownership and timeline look good.
- I'll have infra send the CIDR block list today (we can provide 3 static egress IPs for the trial).
- SSO: we use Okta; I'll attach the SAML metadata and add Sasha to the thread for procurement.
- For the service account, we prefer Redwood create a service principal and share credentials with our SecOps team for rotation. If that's a blocker, tell us.

Two notes:
- Procurement needs a 1-page security summary for internal sign-off (can you point to a short SOC2 / data residency doc?).
- Can Priyom confirm whether the temporary API key will have token-scoped read-only access or full inference access? We want to limit to the test project.

Diego

Diego — hi, thanks for the quick reply. Per Hannah's timeline, here's what I'll do once we receive the SAML metadata + IPs: 

1) SSO: I'll send an Okta SAML SP configuration and an invite to "Apex Insights - Redwood POC". The invite will include instructions for group mapping and an expiration of 30 days.

2) IP allowlist: once you provide the egress IPs, we'll update the private deployment network ACL. Expect an inbound rule change window of ~20 minutes; we'll notify you in Slack.

3) Temporary API credential:
   - Token id: tmp-APX-2026-091-01
   - Scope: inference:run (limited to the test project)
   - Expires: 2026-12-25T23:59:00Z
   NOTE: This is a placeholder token id; actual credential will be delivered via our secure secrets link.

4) Test harness and smoke runs: I'll attach a short runbook with the endpoints, expected headers, and a simple curl example. We'll also provide a small load-driver config that matches your target 40 qps.

Security summary: Neha — copying you to share the one-pager SOC2 link and a brief note on data handling for the private POC (data-at-rest stays on customer infra).

Attached: runbook (inline), sample load config.

Cheers,
Priyom
Staff Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
